description: Read only, instant, no headless run. For a project made with Convert to React (or the imported project it came from): how close each converted page is to the imported one, from the conversion's own check. Per page: the match (0 to 100, where things sit), the pixel score (colours and images at 1280 px) with the best the page can reach, and whether it is under the bar (98 a page, 90 a section). Its weakest sections: label, the main reason (parts missing, moved, of another size, text that wraps differently, the section's height), the score per width and the pixel gap. Sections the conversion printed with the site's own classes, the playbook's known differences and its steps. Pass page for one page with all its kept sections. Start every tidy or repair here, fix the worst section first, then measure that page again with check_match. Skill tidy-converted-site.

page.description: One page, such as "/" or "/about/". Leave out for every page, worst first

projectId.description: The project Convert to React made, or the imported project it came from
